_comment: The main menu's easter egg (work order 327): a hidden star in the background; a click opens Data's thank-you to GetDaved.

star: where the star is, as a fraction of the main menu background picture (assets/shared/backgrounds/main_menu.png, 1812 x 868: the four-pointed star's centre at 368, 444.5 px (pixel i spans i..i+1, as backgrounds.point reads a fraction), measured off the picture and confirmed to 1 px against Data's 2549 x 1440 screenshot of the running menu, the screenshot fitted onto the picture by its pixels). A mod that replaces the background moves the star by replacing this file. hit_radius and glow_radius are in that picture's pixels and scale with it.

blocks: the panel's text, transcribed from Data's mockup, top to bottom. role names the look (screens/main_menu/easteregg.py ROLES); 'line' continues the paragraph above without a gap. English; the German text is easter_egg_de.json (work order 328).
blocks: 16 years ago, a YouTuber named GetDaved introduced me to Master of Orion II.

I was fascinated by the game's mechanics, but the blurry text made playing difficult for my eyes. Instead, I spent countless evenings simply listening to his videos, enjoying a game I could barely play myself.
In 2026, I finally decided to change that.
What began as a personal attempt to make the game easier to enjoy gradually grew into something much bigger than I ever imagined.
Today, I hope OrionLayer will help others discover or rediscover this wonderful game and keep it alive for many more years.
Sometimes, all it takes is someone to light the first spark.
For me, that someone was GetDaved.
And 16 years later, that spark became OrionLayer — a moddable HD overlay for Master of Orion II.
